fb_text:
"Can you prove your crew was there Tuesday?"

A property manager asking for proof isn't picking a fight. It's the job now. They answer to tenants and owners, and "my guy says he was there" doesn't hold up anymore.

The old way: you dig through texts, call your tech, and burn an afternoon on a phone argument nobody wins.

The new way: your crew voice-notes every visit from the truck. FieldNotes turns it into a timestamped service log, and a clean recap goes to the client — but only after you approve it. Nothing sends without your say.

That "were you even there?" email becomes a 30-second reply instead of a dispute.

Built for crews who run their business from text messages. 30 days free, no credit card.

Try the 60-second demo: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
